I weigh '75' kilograms and I'm '180' centimeters tall, and I'd like to use the 'metric' system. Lastly, I've written a piece of text in 'English' and I'd like to perform a sentiment analysis on it. The text is 'I had a wonderful day at the beach. The weather was perfect and I enjoyed a delicious ice cream.' Can you assist me with these?"

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY.

start_date.description: The start date of the reservation. Use format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

language.description: The language in which the text is written.
